data.headline: Senior Leadership in AI/ML, Innovations, Mobility, Transportation, Life Sciences/ BioPharma, Healthcare, Automotive & Manufacturing- Data & Analytics, Smart City, FSD/ADAS, IOT | Software-Defined Products- SDV, SaMD, SDx
data.about:
I bring over 20 years of technology, technical sales/relationship management, and business leadership experience to the engineering, research, and development of emerging technologies and strategies for the mobility, automotive, multi-modal freight, transportation, and logistics industries. My expertise spans software-defined vehicles in automotive/freight/rail/marine/air, EVs, ADAS, autonomous guidance/driving, automation, cybersecurity, organizational and software development strategies, and modeling/training/implementation of AI strategies to include both Predictive and Generative AI. I have supported and won global RFP pursuits worth over a billion dollars in revenue and delivered innovative solutions for clients across every continent, 159 countries, and numerous domains.

I have led the technical sales, development, deployment, and integration of hundreds of applications and configurations for cloud platforms, such as ServiceNow and Salesforce, using agile and SAFe methodologies. I also introduced and integrated innovation strategies, such as ideation, design thinking, human-centric, and AI-driven coding, to enable digital transformation and business outcomes for Global 50 companies in various sectors, such as automotive, freight, shipping, logistics, healthcare, retail, insurance, travel and hospitality, and finance. I have a strong record of success in empowering business outcomes while managing costs, risks, and resources, and a proven ability to recruit, develop, motivate, and retain a global and diverse staff. I am passionate about leveraging technology to create value and solve challenges for organizations and society.

I have had the privilege of working and developing great relationships with major players in multiple domains, such as Tesla, GM, Ford, SAIC, Renault, BMW, Toyota, Honda, Daimler, Paccar, Volta, FedEx, UPS, Element FM, LeasePlan, Samsara, Walmart/ASDA, HCA, BlueCross BlueShield, Tenet Healthcare, Fresenius SE, JPMC, Bank of America, Apple, Boeing, GE, Exxon, Hilton, Marriott, Delta, American Airlines, Princess and Carnival Cruise Lines, Google Waymo, Amazon, and many others, on projects that have honed my expertise in Innovation/Incubation, Mobility, Smart Cities, Sustainability, AI/ML, fleet management, logistics, automation,  data management, autonomous driving systems/robotics, real-time digital twin/shadow mode, and Hyperscalers/Private cloud, multi-cloud technologies across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud, Oracle, Snowflake, AWS VPC, and Dell.
